External bridge source note, 2026-10-08 stage-owned-capability-receipts, UNBUILT/UNRUN/UNDEPLOYED: repeated owned DEFAULT/MANAGED TextureCreationContext format queries now have an optional bounded exact-receipt cache (256 format entries) scoped to the retained TextureFactoryDevice publication. Key includes native device, already-retained IDirect3D9 interface address, adapter ordinal/device type/current display format, usage, resource type and requested format. Only raw S_OK/D3DOK_NOAUTOGEN results are retained; failure/transient/capacity/absent-cache cases keep the existing native query path. Current display is still observed each call; no extra QueryInterface. Publication clear/replacement atomically revokes held old caches; caller freshness checks require current native/publication identity and no release/reset pending. Native calls and freshness callbacks run outside cache locks; optional cache allocation failure is ignored. Describe and per-call modern PlanAllocation and final factory publication check remain. CPU-only SYSTEMMEM/SCRATCH resources bypass cache to preserve their recovery lifetime. This is external source knowledge, not new Oblivion binary behavior or runtime/performance evidence. Source/tests kept separate from installed V266 while manual game run is active.

Validation update 2026-10-08 stage-owned-capability-receipts (external renderer source/host evidence; UNDEPLOYED): after the game exited, Release renderer build passed; d3d9_capability_receipts passed543 checks, owned_capability_receipts_warp passed46 and owned_texture_factories_warp passed5382 with native allocator calls0 (1932 reference cases,456 successes,565 descriptors,3 explicit exclusions). Actual public fixture verifies two exact repeated format requests require one native CheckDeviceFormat, warmed public/worker/recording factories use the receipt, requested/base AUTOGEN responses remain separate, descriptor rejection and current DX11 PlanAllocation still execute, and optional-cache/retirement/Reset/recovery/replacement paths preserve qualification. The CPU check covers exact keys, raw positives, retrying negative/transient results, capacity/absence fallback, reentrancy and concurrent revocation. No cache game runtime/timing/FPS claim; deployed V266 PID18308 did NOT include this code. Successes remain cached for unchanged relevant source. Evidence: stage-owned-capability-receipts/grouped-build.log, grouped-tests.log, grouped-LastTest.log, source-manifest.json and result.md.

External renderer implementation note, 2026-10-08 V266 candidate (source review; validation pending): audit found StoreD3D9Device discarded InstallDeviceMethodHooks failure while CreateDeviceHookImpl still adopted the device. Candidate refuses InstallDeviceMethodHooks=0 before native allocation; preflights all device routes on the newly created native device before releasing an existing modern backend; rejects/nulls/releases an incomplete candidate. Exact stored identity and installation success are checked again before ownership preparations. Failed preflight can leave safe foreign-dispatch hooks in shared native tables; this does NOT roll all table patches back or remove native device/bootstrap allocation. This is external bridge implementation, not a new Oblivion binary inference. Evidence: analysis/dx11_completion/stage-v266-backend-candidate.

The failed preflight is not a rollback of every shared vtable patch; later unrelated preparation failures remain outside its preservation guarantee. Actual Oblivion deployment/runtime acceptance remains pending. Receipts: stage-v266-backend-candidate/LastTest.log and tests.log.
